scope: Guard, metadata and dummy worker only. No XAI/scientific packages or mechanism calculations.
architecture: Existing same-job controller plus one suspended sequential worker; detached launch; controller watchdog thread; no extra controlled helper. Completion port adds telemetry, not processes.
retry_policy: Each case one explicit launch. At most2 recorded corrective reruns for implementation defects, no automatic retry. Preserve every result.
selftest_scale: Memory probes96MiB; other job-memory limits remain2GiB. Short timeouts use same watchdog path with separate explicit test settings. No claim of real600/605second validation.
memory_procedure: Fixed held40MiB controller, child16MiB then32MiB expected denial, release held40MiB then separate32MiB positive control; no cap increase. Before/after assignment and allocation snapshots, completionport events, global commit headroom.
class28_policy: Optional target-build diagnostic only unless supported definition established. Do not base hard enforcement on undocumented fields.
stop_policy: Unexpected topology, accounting uncertainty or incomplete timing evidence keeps RESOURCE_GUARD_BLOCKED. No native launch even if READY.
publication: No commit,push,merge. All old artifacts unchanged.
